integrity: Analytic proof with supplemental exact rational finite-cylinder checks; independent validation has not occurred.
limitations: Specific to two polynomials and clipped state feedback with 0<alpha<1 and 0<epsilon<1/2.
Only endpoint regularity; no assertion of global Hölder regularity or a complete multifractal spectrum.
Non-power profile witness proved at alpha=1/2 and epsilon=1/4 only.
Potential equivalent general endpoint local-dimension theorem outside inspected sources remains a priority risk.
scientific_summary: Exact two-boundary renormalization for the clipped affine-feedback model of Endo, with uniform sharp pointwise radial exponent and a proven non-power endpoint example.
title: Sharp boundary regularity and exact dyadic profiles for clipped random quadratic dynamics
